notes: Hand-written examples created for this runner. They are not sampled from SecVulEval and contain no dataset indices, CVE/CWE identifiers, or ground-truth metadata. The runner rejects any example whose normalised code matches an evaluation function.

detection.rationale: The destination buffer is written without a size or length check, so a long source can overflow it.
The function validates its pointers, measures the source, and rejects inputs that do not fit the destination.
The caller-controlled string is used as a format string, so format specifiers in it can trigger memory-safety bugs.
The function validates both pointers, requires exactly one character, and checks that it is a digit before writing one byte.

repair.explanation: Check the destination size and source length before copying so the write cannot exceed dst_size.
Validate the pointer and index against the supplied length before reading.
